stem.text: In the diagram, each test-tube W, X, Y and Z contains $25\,\text{cm}^3$ of a $0.1\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ solution of a salt.

stem.alt: Four test-tubes labelled W, X, Y and Z, each containing 25 cm3 of solution. W and Y contain BaCl2(aq); X and Z contain MgCl2(aq).

stem.text: To test-tubes W and X, $25\,\text{cm}^3$ of $0.1\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ is added.
To test-tubes Y and Z, $25\,\text{cm}^3$ of $0.1\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq)}$ is added.
In which of test-tubes W and X does the liquid have the higher pH and which of test-tubes Y and Z has the greater mass of precipitate?
